subject_line: From Escape from Amsterdam to the stories of The Angel Tiger
email_body:
Dear Barrie,

Your path from the novels The Pillow Book of Lady Kasa and Escape from Amsterdam to The Angel Tiger, a story collection published by Epigram in 2019 while you were coordinating creative writing at NTU, caught my attention. I'd be interested in how the short form changed the way you work, and whether writing and teaching in Singapore found its way into those stories.

The Author Ledger is an independent project featuring short Author Spotlights. Each portrait is built from a few written questions that the author answers at their own pace, and the full text is shared with them for review before publication.

Would you be open to taking part? No pressure either way.

Best regards,
The Author Ledger
hook_note: Novels The Pillow Book of Lady Kasa and Escape from Amsterdam (Granta), story collection The Angel Tiger (Epigram 2019); NTU creative writing coordinator per Australian Short Story Festival bio and NTU staff page. Email seen in search result (NTU ACWP contact page).
